scope: The Rab fusion protein biotinylates proximal proteins that are then purified on streptavidin and identified through mass spectrometry (MS).
AP of biotinylated proteins was carried out by incubation of clarified lysates with streptavidin-coated magnetic Dynabeads (ThermoFisher) for 24 h at 4 °C.

Washed beads from BioID experiments with HeLa cells were subjected to limited proteolysis by trypsin (0.3 μg) at 27 °C for 6.5 h in 2 mM urea, 1 mM DTT, 75 mM Tris, pH = 8.5, and then supernatants were incubated overnight at 37 °C.
